messages.subject: Re: Tips on downloading session code
parts:
Pandoc is a tool for converting documents, it comes included with RStudio. You can check what version of pandoc you have installed by running:
library(rmarkdown)
pandoc_version()

This should return your version number, and I expect it to be earlier than v1.12.3 as your error message is indicating. What version of Rstudio are you running Wallace on? You can check this as any other software, in the top panel: RStudio > About Rstudio
For example, I am using Rstudio 2022.07.1 and it includes pandoc 2.18. 

I think you might just need to update your Rstudio. Do note that within the last year, Rstudio has rebranded itself as Posit. I haven't updated since before the rebranding, just a heads up in case you see "Posit" instead of Rstudio, although I believe the download is still called Rstudio.
